title: Optimizing Singular Spectrum for Large Language Model Compression
abstract: arXiv:2502.15092v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, yet prohibitive parameter complexity often hinders their deployment. Existing singular value decomposition (SVD) based compression methods simply deem singular values as importance scores of decomposed components. However, this importance ordered by singular values does not necessarily correlate with the performance of a downstream task. In this work, we introduce SoCo (Singular spectrum optimization for large language model Compression), a novel compression framework that learns to rescale the decomposed components of SVD in a data-driven manner. Concretely, we employ a learnable diagonal matrix to assign importance scores for singular spectrum and develop a three-stage training process that progressively refines these scores from initial coarse compression to fine-grained sparsification-thereby striking an effective balance between aggressive model compression

translated_title: 优化奇异谱以实现大语言模型压缩
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已展现出卓越的能力，但其令人望而却步的参数复杂度常常阻碍了模型的部署。现有的基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩方法简单地将奇异值视为分解组件的重要性分数。然而，这种由奇异值排序的重要性并不一定与下游任务的性能相关。在本工作中，我们提出了SoCo（面向大语言模型压缩的奇异谱优化），这是一种新颖的压缩框架，能够以数据驱动的方式学习对SVD分解组件进行重新缩放。具体而言，我们采用可学习的对角矩阵为奇异谱分配重要性分数，并开发了一个三阶段训练过程，从初始的粗粒度压缩到细粒度稀疏化逐步精炼这些分数——从而在激进模型压缩与性能保持之间取得有效平衡。
tldr: 提出SoCo压缩框架，通过可学习的对角矩阵以数据驱动方式重新缩放SVD分解组件的重要性分数，并采用三阶段训练过程，在大语言模型压缩与性能保持之间实现有效平衡。
